task_description: Write a method in Dafny to interchange the first and last elements in a array.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method SwapFirstAndLast(a: array<int>)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The first element of the input array should be the last element of the modified array
    - The last element of the input array should be the first element of the modified array
    - All other elements remain unchanged
code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.  
In this case:  
    method SwapFirstAndLast(a: array<int>)  

Step 2: Determine the preconditions.  
In this case:  
Natural language description:  
    - The array should not be empty to perform a swap between first and last elements.  
  
Dafny specification:  
    requires a.Length > 0;  

Step 3: Determine the postconditions.  
In this case:  
Natural language description:  
    - The first element of the array should be the original last element  
- The last element of the array should be the original first element  
- All other elements remain unchanged  
  
Dafny specification:  
    ensures a[0] == old(a[a.Length - 1])  
    ensures a[a.Length - 1] == old(a[0])  
    ensures forall k :: 1 <= k < a.Length - 1 ==> a[k] == old(a[k])  

Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.  
In this case:

```dafny
method SwapFirstAndLast(a: array<int>)
  requires a.Length > 0
  modifies a
  ensures a[0] == old(a[a.Length - 1])
  ensures a[a.Length - 1] == old(a[0])
  ensures forall k :: 1 <= k < a.Length - 1 ==> a[k] == old(a[k])
{
    var tmp := a[0];
    a[0] := a[a.Length - 1];
    a[a.Length - 1] := tmp;
}
```
